review_procedures.name: Sequential Expert Evaluation with Cross-Validation

evaluation_steps.deliverables: Detailed evaluation scorecard with technical findings and risk assessment
Validated technical concerns and architectural alignment verification
Consolidated risk register with prioritized mitigation strategies
Ranked solution matrix with implementation readiness assessment

coordination_requirements: Share technical evaluation criteria before review starts
Coordinate on overlapping architectural concerns (memory-context-agent integration)
Resolve conflicts between implementation approaches and domain requirements
Validate timeline feasibility across all expert perspectives

scoring_system.critical_threshold: 6.0 minimum per dimension (below triggers automatic rejection)

issue_classification.definition: Prevents implementation or violates critical requirements
issue_classification.action_required: Must resolve before proceeding with solution

issue_classification.definition: Significant impact on system architecture or domain compliance
issue_classification.action_required: Must address in implementation planning phase
Address during implementation or as technical debt
Consider for future iterations or optimizations

feedback_specifications.format: Structured technical evaluation with evidence-based scoring

required_sections.content: Overall score, key technical strengths, critical architectural concerns, implementation readiness assessment
Detailed technical evaluation per criterion with specific evidence, code examples, and performance projections
Prioritized risk analysis with severity classification, probability assessment, and mitigation recommendations
Phased implementation recommendations with timeline estimates, resource requirements, and success metrics
Expert domain concerns, compliance requirements, and specialized implementation requirements

feedback_specifications.format: Executive summary with detailed technical appendices and decision matrix
synthesis_requirements: Aggregate individual expert scores into weighted overall rating for each solution
Identify common technical themes and resolve conflicting expert recommendations
Prioritize implementation risks by combined severity and expert consensus
Create detailed implementation timeline integrating all expert domain requirements
Establish clear go/no-go criteria with measurable success metrics

review_cycles.trigger: All 6 solutions ready for comprehensive review
review_cycles.expected_outcomes: Solution ranking with top 2-3 candidates identified

review_cycles.trigger: Top candidates identified from initial review
review_cycles.expert_participation: Memory Architecture + Integration Specialist + Context Engineering
review_cycles.expected_outcomes: Detailed implementation plans for top candidates with risk mitigation

review_cycles.trigger: Implementation plans completed for top candidates
review_cycles.expected_outcomes: Single solution selection with approved implementation roadmap

decision_criteria: No P0 blockers identified by any expert
Maximum 3 P1 risks with clear mitigation strategies
Implementation timeline feasible within resource constraints

review_process_metrics: All 5 expert panels complete evaluation within 2 business days
Technical consensus achieved on solution ranking with <10% score variance

Implementation feasibility validation: Timeline and resource requirements confirmed

Zero P0 blockers and maximum 3 P1 risks with mitigation strategies
Swiss healthcare domain compliance: 100% regulatory requirement coverage
Agent workflow preservation: 100% existing functionality maintained
deliverable_quality_metrics: Expert report completeness: All required sections with evidence-based analysis
Cross-expert consistency: Technical findings align within acceptable variance
Implementation roadmap accuracy: Timeline estimates validated by integration specialist
